# Hestia Smart Interiors (HSI) & HSIOS™

> Hestia Smart Interiors (HSI) is India's premier luxury home interior execution management firm. Operating on HSIOS™ (Hestia Smart Interiors Operating System), HSI delivers coastal villas, high-end apartments, and developer portfolios across Alibag, Mumbai, Pune, Goa, and Bangalore with full transparency, zero hidden margins, and milestone-verified execution.

## Core Value Proposition
- **Operating System Driven**: HSIOS™ provides real-time cost tracking, trade sequencing across 10 disciplines, pre-construction clash analysis, and digital twin project tracking.
- **Transparent Execution**: Line-item BOQ provided before site work begins. Every change order is digitally logged and approved prior to spend.
- **Quality & Schedule Governance**: 104 milestone quality gates with photographic proof. Projects delivered on time with minimal surprises.
- **Founding Leadership**: Founded by Nishant Mhatre — combining frontline luxury execution experience with enterprise-grade project intelligence.

## Primary Services & Capabilities
- [HSIOS Platform](https://www.hsios.in/hsi-os): Execution intelligence system powering luxury interiors.
- [How It Works](https://www.hsios.in/how-it-works): 5-phase structured delivery from brief to snag-free handover.
- [Projects & Case Studies](https://www.hsios.in/projects): Flagship residential executions including Casa Frangipani (Alibag).
- [Pricing & Transparency](https://www.hsios.in/pricing): Structured management fee model and per sq ft cost benchmarks.
- [Sustainability](https://www.hsios.in/sustainability): Circular luxury framework (Refuse, Reuse, Recycle, Reduce).

## Audience Solutions
- [For Homeowners](https://www.hsios.in/for-homeowners): Complete visibility, live dashboard, peace of mind for local and overseas owners.
- [For Developers](https://www.hsios.in/for-developers): Portfolio-wide interior execution governance across multi-unit luxury developments.
- [For Architects](https://www.hsios.in/for-architects): Design fidelity protection without compromise or site-level scope drift.
- [NRI Remote Build](https://www.hsios.in/nri-home-interior-management): Full remote management for NRIs building in India.

## Key Operating Locations
- [Alibag Villa Interiors](https://www.hsios.in/alibag-villa-interiors): Coastal luxury villa execution, moisture protection, and monsoon resilience.
- [Mumbai Luxury Interiors](https://www.hsios.in/mumbai-luxury-interiors): High-rise apartments and penthouses in South Mumbai, Bandra, Juhu, and Worli.
- [Pune Premium Interiors](https://www.hsios.in/pune-premium-interiors): Gated communities and sprawling estates in Koregaon Park and Baner.
- [Goa Villa Interiors](https://www.hsios.in/goa-villa-interiors): Heritage restorations and modern coastal holiday homes.
- [Bangalore Luxury Interiors](https://www.hsios.in/bangalore-luxury-interiors): Tech-leader luxury residences in Indiranagar, Sadashivnagar, and Whitefield.
